entities.name: Audrey
entities.description: Audrey, a city-dwelling dog owner and Andrew's long-standing friend, who caught up with him every week or two through 2023. Her life revolves around her four small mutts Pepper, Precious, Panda and Pixie: a positive-reinforcement training course, agility classes, a grooming course, a dog owners group, two tattoos of her dogs, daily walks, road trips and hikes. She also cooks, keeps a small garden, and makes and sells jewellery from recycled materials, donating part of the profits to an animal shelter. She moved to a home with a bigger backyard in June 2023 and broke her arm in a park accident in October 2023.

entities.name: Andrew
entities.description: Andrew, who started a job as a Financial Analyst in March 2023 and lives in the city with his girlfriend. Hiking, birds and the outdoors are what he values most, and work stress and city living kept taking them away from him through 2023. After months of searching for a dog-friendly place to live he brought home the German Shepherd puppy Toby in July 2023, adopted Buddy from a shelter in October 2023 and Scout in November 2023. Audrey's friend and regular correspondent.

entities.name: Andrew's girlfriend
entities.description: Andrew's girlfriend, never named in the conversation. She shares nearly all of his outings: city cafes and restaurants, a farm visit for vegetables, fishing at a nearby lake, camping with Toby, volunteering at a pet shelter, a wine tasting, board-game nights, a bike ride to a park outside town, and planned trips to the beach and a picnic. She adopted Scout with him in November 2023.

properties.aliases: his GF, my girl, the gf

entities.name: Pepper
entities.description: One of Audrey's four dogs, and one of the three she had already had for about three years in March 2023. A mutt — Audrey called her a Jack Russell mix in July and September 2023 and a Lab mix in October 2023. She took a while to accept the puppy Pixie in April 2023 and then became inseparable from her. Her favourite spot is the couch.

entities.name: Precious
entities.description: One of Audrey's four dogs, with her since about 2020 alongside Pepper and Panda. A mutt, described as a Chihuahua mix in October 2023. Andrew identified her as the dog whose leash snapped at the park on 22 September 2023 and who had to be chased down. She relaxes in her own chair.

entities.name: Panda
entities.description: One of Audrey's four dogs, with her since about 2020 alongside Pepper and Precious. A mutt, described as a Lab mix in October 2023. He likes to relax on his rug.

entities.name: Pixie
entities.description: The small white puppy Audrey adopted at the end of March 2023, making four dogs. Described as a Chihuahua mix in October 2023. She took a few days to settle in with the other three and then became inseparable from Pepper. She curls up in her own bed.

entities.name: Max
entities.description: Audrey's childhood dog, full of energy and a keen fetch player. She took long walks around the neighbourhood with him as a child, sniffing out new paths, and confided her worries and hopes in him; she remembers him as a great listener and those walks as some of her favourite memories.

entities.name: Toby
entities.description: Andrew's German Shepherd, brought home as a puppy in July 2023 after months of searching — his first dog of his own. Active, fond of sweaters, and once chased a squirrel round a tree at the dog park. He goes camping and to board-game nights with Andrew and his girlfriend, was still too young to hike in September 2023, and was joined by Buddy in October and Scout in November 2023.

entities.name: Buddy
entities.description: The dog Andrew adopted from a shelter in October 2023, named Buddy because he is Andrew's buddy and because Andrew hoped he and Toby would become buddies. He and Andrew walk together and he loves checking out new hiking trails.

entities.name: Scout
entities.description: The third dog Andrew and his girlfriend adopted, in November 2023, named after a while deliberating because the name suited the pup's adventurous spirit. Kept on a leash outdoors at first, with a bed, toys and puppy pads at home, while being introduced slowly to Toby and Buddy.

entities.name: Fox Hollow
entities.description: A hiking trail Andrew recommended to Audrey on 27 March 2023 as a great weekend hike with awesome views. A week later she still had not tried it, because the new puppy Pixie was keeping her busy.

entities.name: Audrey's positive-reinforcement dog training course
entities.description: The positive-reinforcement dog training class Audrey signed up for on 11 May 2023 after seeing a flyer at her local pet store, held from June 2023 and still running on 3 July 2023, when she called it challenging, rewarding and a big time sink that was already paying off in her dogs' behaviour. Andrew said she had nearly sold him on it. She used its techniques again in October 2023 on the behaviourist's advice.

entities.name: Audrey's dog agility classes
entities.description: Agility classes Audrey started with her four dogs at a dog park in early August 2023, attending twice a week. She calls them a physical and mental workout and a bonding experience, and enjoys watching the dogs face obstacles and build relationships with other dogs.

entities.name: Audrey's dog grooming course
entities.description: The dog grooming course Audrey took in August 2023, which taught her to groom her four dogs herself: work slowly and gently, pay attention to sensitive areas like ears and paws, and stay patient and positive throughout.

entities.name: Audrey's dog owners group
entities.description: A group of dog owners Audrey joined around early November 2023 to learn to take better care of her dogs. She tries to meet them about once a week, for tips from other owners and so the dogs can play together.

entities.name: The animal shelter Audrey donates to
entities.description: The animal shelter Audrey gives a portion of her recycled-jewellery profits to. In October 2023 she called it a cause close to her heart that does great work, and her way of helping out when she cannot be there in person.

entities.name: The pet shelter Andrew volunteered at
entities.description: The pet shelter where Andrew and his girlfriend volunteered on Monday 24 July 2023. He called it one of the most rewarding things he had ever done and their way of giving back, and it reminded him how much he loves animals.

entities.name: hiking
entities.description: The shared centre of Audrey and Andrew's friendship. Andrew calls hiking the best of the outdoor activities and nature a reset button and a home for his soul; how much of it he can get is the running theme of his year. Audrey hikes with her four dogs, on trails, in national parks and on a two-hour trail hike in August 2023. Their plan to hike together with the dogs runs from July 2023 to a date finally set for 4 November 2023.

entities.name: rock climbing
entities.description: Andrew took a rock climbing class with friends on Sunday 11 June 2023, found it tricky as a newbie but reached the top with his friends' encouragement, and said he was hooked and proud of himself. It made him want to try kayaking and possibly bungee jumping.

entities.name: cooking
entities.description: A hobby both of them share. Audrey loves experimenting with recipes, calls it an escape, self-care and therapeutic, uses garlic as her go-to ingredient, and offered Andrew her family's Chicken Pot Pie and a Mediterranean-inspired Roasted Chicken. Andrew took it up in mid-2023 while he could not hike, as a way to de-stress and be creative, and it became one of his favourite hobbies.

entities.name: making jewellery from recycled materials
entities.description: Audrey makes one-of-a-kind jewellery out of bottle caps, buttons and broken jewellery she hunts down, combining her love of creativity and sustainability and reducing waste. It began as a hobby and became something she sells, donating a portion of the profits to an animal shelter.

entities.name: gardening
entities.description: Audrey keeps a small garden of flowers — Peruvian Lilies, which she says need only water and enough sun — and a vegetable patch, which she finds relaxing and rewarding, and which her dogs run around in. Andrew tends flowers on his balcony and, in October 2023, considered more houseplants to bring some peace into his city home.

entities.name: birdwatching
entities.description: Andrew has been awed by birds, especially eagles, since before the conversation began; in March 2023 he had never gone out deliberately but spotted them while hiking, and by October 2023 he claimed some experience and offered to bring binoculars and a notebook. Audrey took the interest up in October 2023 with a birdwatching guidebook and a plan to learn her area's common birds, and the two agreed to go together.

entities.name: grooming her own dogs
entities.description: Grooming she learned to do herself in August 2023 and said brought her closer to her dogs: daily brushing, regular baths, nail trims and lots of love. She still took all four to a pet salon in November 2023.

entities.name: cycling
entities.description: Raised by Andrew on 1 October 2023 as a way to cut a carbon footprint; he knows good routes near the river and offered to show Audrey the best of them. He and his girlfriend rode to a park outside town at the end of October 2023.

entities.name: Audrey's knee injury
entities.description: A knee injury Audrey suffered at some point before October 2023 that stopped her walking her dogs, which she found hard because they bring her so much joy. She recovered, and photographed the dogs on her first walk back.

entities.name: Audrey's broken arm
entities.description: The arm Audrey injured in an accident while playing with her dogs at the park in the week before 24 October 2023. She wore a cast, found looking after four dogs one-handed tricky but manageable, and said she was feeling better each day.

entities.name: Andrew's search for a dog
entities.description: Andrew's search for a dog of his own, running from spring 2023 — browsing websites, visiting shelters and asking friends of theirs — to July 2023, when he brought home the puppy Toby. He reasoned that a smaller dog suited apartment life and matched a breed's exercise needs to living space, and ended up with a German Shepherd anyway.

entities.name: Andrew's search for a dog-friendly home
entities.description: Andrew's long search for a dog-friendly place to live in the city, from April 2023 onwards: rental websites with filters, contacting landlords and walking neighbourhoods, hoping for somewhere near a park or woods where a dog could run. Still unresolved in September 2023; by November 2023 he said he had made it work with dogs while still living in the city.

entities.name: Audrey and Andrew's hike together with their dogs
entities.description: The hike Audrey and Andrew planned to take together with their dogs. Proposed in July 2023 for the following month, still unrealised through October, and finally arranged for Saturday 4 November 2023 on a dog-friendly trail by a lake, with snacks, after which they talked about a second trail with autumn colours.
